# 47 Say Ab Tak — Complete Pakistan Legal & Citizen Documentation Handbook

## 1. NADRA Identity & Civil Registry
### 1.1 CNIC & Smart Card (New, Renewal, Duplicate)
- Department: National Database & Registration Authority (NADRA)
- Eligibility: Pakistani citizens aged 18+
- Processing Time: Executive (Same Day), Urgent (7 Days), Normal (15 Days)
- Required Documents: Original Birth/Matric Certificate or Father/Mother original CNIC, blood relative for biometric verification.
- Official URL: https://47sayabtak.com/guides/cnic

### 1.2 Family Registration Certificate (FRC)
- Purpose: Visa, embassy, inheritance, and succession proof of family lineage.
- Processing: Instant at NADRA Mega Centers / 24h via Pak-Identity app.
- Official URL: https://47sayabtak.com/guides/frc

### 1.3 Succession Certificate & Letter of Administration
- Legal Basis: Succession Act / NADRA Succession Ordinance.
- Processing Time: 15 to 30 Days (includes mandatory 14-day newspaper notice).
- Official URL: https://47sayabtak.com/guides/succession

## 2. Land Records & Property (PLRA)
### 2.1 Fard Malkiat (Land Ownership Extract)
- Department: Punjab Land Records Authority (PLRA) / Sindh Zameen
- Processing Time: 15 minutes at ARC or instant online via PLRA portal.
- Official URL: https://47sayabtak.com/guides/fard

### 2.2 Land Mutation (Intiqal)
- Types: Sale (Baye), Gift (Tamleek), Inheritance (Wirasat).
- Official URL: https://47sayabtak.com/guides/land-mutation

## 3. Educational & Legal Attestation Sequence
- Mandatory Sequence: IBCC -> HEC -> MOFA Apostille
- Official URL: https://47sayabtak.com/guides/document-attestation

## 4. FBR Tax & ATL Filer Status
- Department: Federal Board of Revenue (FBR)
- Portal: IRIS 2.0 (iris.fbr.gov.pk)
- Official URL: https://47sayabtak.com/guides/ntn-registration
